system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Input, Analysis, and Summary memories are retrieved during the Reasoning process; Ac-
tion and Observation memories are retrieved during the
Execution process
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; prompt composed per step from retrieved memory categories and mandatory requirement reminder.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
The hand-level Agent generates
demand-matching file operation functions based on the task
requirements, which are then invoked within a sandbox envi-
ronment.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
The summarization process is essentially a com-
pression of the execution steps and results from the current
turn.
context_compaction.note: Memory retrieval also filters typed memory instances (Analysis class) per role; coded structured_checkpoint.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
We plan to expand the current Agent framework from
a text modality to a multimodal one.

tool_call_format.note: Paper shows edit_file(...) call syntax but no parser; no code available.

tool_count.note: No tool registry available; paper names edit_file, open_file, replace_function, Trace_code_switch, browser commands.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
replace function(file name,
function to replace, new code), which re-
places a specific function in a given file based on its
signature
edit_primitive.note: edit_file with start_line/end_line plus line-string checks = line_range_edit; replace_function coded ast_aware (signature-based, mechanism unclear).

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependency list available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
it will sequentially
perform the following actions: reasoning and analysis, task
scheduling, task execution, results evaluation, and summa-
rization.
loop_primitives.note: Evaluation with retry on failure -> generate_test_repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
The output of this step includes specific task objec-
tive, detailed steps, and expected outcome.
planning_granularity.note: Brain agent emits task objects delegated to hand agents; Fig. 2 shows task decomposition.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
agents are
divided into brain-level and hand-level agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
the brain-level Agent will assigns it to the hand-level
Agent.
delegation_mechanism.note: Could equally be role_handoff; mechanism not described.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: It is a fully autonomous, multi-agent workflow that integrates step-by- step reasoning, tool invocation, environment interaction, feedback adjustments, and evaluation summaries. Each step in this process is autonomously determined by the Agent itself.
human_in_loop.note: The paper states outright that the run is fully autonomous after the user's input. There is no code to confirm the absence of any confirmation hooks.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
uniformly stored in
historical memory as instances in sequence.

long_term_memory.note: Memory mechanism described is within-run; cross-run memory not discussed.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
Automated linting prompts
were enabled after code edits
self_verification.note: Brain agent evaluates hand-agent results against expected output (self_critique, same brain model).

retry_policy.note: Experiment setting; may be step-level rather than whole-task.

rollback.evidence_quote:
allows for modifi-
cation of these patches at any time using git commands.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
maximum number of iterations was set to 100, with up
to 3 self-correction attempts.
termination_condition.note: Agent executes exit command when done (Sec. 3.1); max cost $10.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
For simple and repetitive tasks, smaller
and cheaper, or open-source models are utilized for ex-
ecution, serving as the hands of the Agent.

timeouts.evidence_quote:
the maximum timeout in the
sandbox was set to120s

network_policy.note: Browser tool implies network, but no config surface.

eval_hooks.note: Evaluated on SWE-bench-lite, but no repo to check for built-in runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
If they do
not match, the Agent will automatically issue prompt
commands to guide the LLM in adjusting the original
edit file() command until it matches correctly.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
invoking dif-
ferent tools, such as file editing, web browsing, and code
execution.

open_source.note: Table 1 lists Open Source as '-' for Infant Agent; no repo URL.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
The litellm package was used to
standardize the output format for both Claude-3.5-Sonnet
and GPT-4o.

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date; no repo/tag available.
